page.content:
Born in Yamakoshi, Niigata. Working mainly on shows such as and . Eri's work on the JoJo TV anime consists primarily of key animation, but she has also supervised for David Production's other series.

page.overview:
Who is Eri Kojima?

Born in Yamakoshi, Niigata. Working mainly on shows such as and . Eri's work on the JoJo TV anime consists primarily of key animation, but she has also supervised for David Production's other series.
